issues.detail: Published as Jul 2024 but the whole workbook is Jun 2024's (identical to the file published for that earlier month); file a56484f3, posted in 5 section(s): DISCO's Consumption, Fuel Mix, Hourly Generation Profile, Marginal Price vs Demand, System at Glance. Anyone using ISMO's site for Jul 2024 gets the wrong month.

Published as Jan 2025 but the whole workbook is Mar 2025's (identical file also published as that month, and it fits that month's hourly prices); file f2cf7e0b, posted in 1 section(s): Marginal Price vs Demand. Anyone using ISMO's site for Jan 2025 gets the wrong month.

Published as Apr 2025 but the whole workbook is Mar 2025's (identical file also published as that month, and it fits that month's hourly prices); file f2cf7e0b, posted in 4 section(s): DISCO's Consumption, Fuel Mix, Hourly Generation Profile, System at Glance. Anyone using ISMO's site for Apr 2025 gets the wrong month.

16 files listed in ISMO's own index no longer exist on its server: DISCOs Consumption July 2026; DISCOs Consumption June 2026; Detailed Design Of CTBCM In Pakistan 10-06-2021; Fuel Mix July 2026; Fuel Mix June 2026; Hourly Generation July 2026; Hourly Generation June 2026; Introduction To CTBCM In Pakistan 31-03-2021; June 2026; Marginal Cost Vs Demand July 2026; Marginal Price July 2024 to June 2026; Marginal Price Vs demand June 2026; System at a Glance July 2026; System at a Glance June 2026
File published in ISMO's market-data section is not market data (no market-data sheets; original file 'BD Outreach - Extended Sizes_ismo_qAdI09AsR8.xlsx'). Not loaded, and its contents were not read.
Feb 2025: published price profile does not reconcile with ISMO's own hourly prices (average gap Rs 10.98/kWh); it is not the monthly average of the hourly data
Aug 2026: published price profile does not reconcile with ISMO's own hourly prices (average gap Rs 6.36/kWh); it is not the monthly average of the hourly data
Apr 2026: plant count jumps to 135 (+108%) with no matching change in energy: CPPA-G changed how plants are listed, so plant-level series are not comparable across this date
Hourly demand published only up to 30 Jun 2025 while prices run to 31 Aug 2026

Feb 2025 marginal_cost_rs_kwh: correctly filed copies of this month disagree on 24 values (largest gap 15.96); ISMO re-issued the month with changed numbers. The copy posted 20 Mar 2025 in 'Marginal Price vs Demand' matches the hourly prices exactly; the earlier copy in DISCO's Consumption, Fuel Mix, Hourly Generation Profile, System at Glance was never replaced.

The copy posted 20 Apr 2025 in 'Marginal Price vs Demand' matches the hourly prices exactly; the earlier copy in DISCO's Consumption, Fuel Mix, Hourly Generation Profile, System at Glance was never replaced.

Jan 2026 marginal_cost_rs_kwh: correctly filed copies of this month disagree on 15 values (largest gap 1.19); ISMO re-issued the month with changed numbers. The copy posted 20 Feb 2026 in 'Marginal Price vs Demand' matches the hourly prices exactly; the earlier copy in DISCO's Consumption, Fuel Mix, Hourly Generation Profile, System at Glance was never replaced.
11 hours where metered demand exceeds total generation (worst -6.1%): physically impossible, likely metering or reporting error

HPS WAPDA Tarbela: 2064 hours above 115% of its listed dependable capacity (3478 MW listed, peak 5015 MW). More likely a registry mismatch (units combined in the generation feed but listed separately in the capacity table) than real overproduction; the capacity figure should be corrected before use.

HPS WAPDA Mangla: 138 hours above 115% of its listed dependable capacity (920 MW listed, peak 1147 MW). More likely a registry mismatch (units combined in the generation feed but listed separately in the capacity table) than real overproduction; the capacity figure should be corrected before use.

disco_demand_mw: hourly figures for 1 series (PESCO) are identical to Jan 2024's in 1 later workbook(s) (Feb 2024). The sheet was carried forward instead of being recalculated; anyone reading these hourly values gets Jan 2024's numbers.

gen_mw: hourly figures for 1 series (thermal_other) are identical to Jan 2025's in 1 later workbook(s) (Feb 2025). The sheet was carried forward instead of being recalculated; anyone reading these hourly values gets Jan 2025's numbers.

gen_mw_share_sheet: hourly figures for 7 series (bagasse, coal, hydro, nuclear, solar, thermal_other, wind) are identical to Sep 2023's in 3 later workbook(s) (Oct 2023 to Dec 2023). The sheet was carried forward instead of being recalculated; anyone reading these hourly values gets Sep 2023's numbers.

gen_mw_share_sheet: hourly figures for 7 series (bagasse, coal, hydro, nuclear, solar, thermal_other, wind) are identical to Mar 2024's in 21 later workbook(s) (Apr 2024 to Aug 2026). The sheet was carried forward instead of being recalculated; anyone reading these hourly values gets Mar 2024's numbers.

gen_mw_share_sheet: hourly figures for 7 series (bagasse, coal, hydro, nuclear, solar, thermal_other, wind) are identical to May 2025's in 4 later workbook(s) (Jun 2025 to Sep 2025). The sheet was carried forward instead of being recalculated; anyone reading these hourly values gets May 2025's numbers.

marginal_cost_rs_kwh: hourly figures for 1 series (system) are identical to Jan 2024's in 1 later workbook(s) (Feb 2024). The sheet was carried forward instead of being recalculated; anyone reading these hourly values gets Jan 2024's numbers.

marginal_cost_rs_kwh: hourly figures for 1 series (system) are identical to Jan 2025's in 1 later workbook(s) (Feb 2025). The sheet was carried forward instead of being recalculated; anyone reading these hourly values gets Jan 2025's numbers.
All 19,008 hours present from 01 Jul 2024 to 31 Aug 2026
All 8,760 hours present
All 130 plants report all 8,760 hours
All 24 months present (Jul 2024 to Jun 2026)
12 locations, 496,512 hourly observations to 20 Sep 2026
24 correctly filed months reconcile with the hourly prices (median gap Rs 0.00/kWh)

59 stretches of 12+ hours at an unchanged price; longest 55 hours at Rs 21.84 from 09 Dec 2024. Plausible when one plant stays marginal; a feed stuck on one value would look the same, so these are listed for review.
Up to date: latest hour 31 Aug 2026 23:00
9 early files (Dec 2022 to Mar 2023) are single-day snapshots, not monthly averages; kept on disk, not loaded
Generation exceeds metered demand by 2.7% (median), consistent with transmission losses
5 published versions compared over 18,264 overlapping hours: no past value was ever revised
